default_in_repayment.text:
In our opinion and according to the information and explanations given to us, the company has not defaulted in the repayment of loans or borrowings to financial institutions, banks and government. The company has not issued any debentures.
The company is not declared a willful defaulter by any bank or financial institution or other lender.

fraud.text:
To the best of our knowledge and according to the information and explanations given to us, no fraud by the company or any fraud on the Company by its officers or employees has been noticed or reported during the year.
No report under sub-Section (12) of Section 143 of the Companies Act has been filed by the auditors in Form ADT-4 as prescribed under Rule 13 of Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules 2014 with the Central Government.
Whistle-blower complaints have not been received during the year by the Company.

statutory_dues.text:
(a) The Company is regular in depositing undisputed statutory dues including provident fund, employees` state insurance, income-tax, goods and service tax, customs duty, cess and any other statutory dues have been regularly paid to the appropriate authorities.

(b) According to the information and explanations given to us there are no dues of sales tax, income tax, goods and service tax, customs duty, cess and any other statutory dues which have not been deposited on account of any dispute.

timeline.summary: Gretex Corporate Services signed a listing mandate with a Maharashtra-based EV manufacturer.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹34.82 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹7.19 Cr.
Gretex Corporate Services filed a revised May 7 board outcome, correcting the warrant count for two allottees in its ₹69.85 Cr preferential issue of 19,51,000 warrants at ₹358 each.
SEBI registered Celestial Chakra Trust, sponsored and managed by Gretex's 50:50 JV Bautex Ventures LLP, as a Category II AIF on May 05, 2026.
Gretex Corporate Services signed a listing mandate with a West Bengal-based ferro alloys company for an SME/Emerge platform listing.
Bhavna Desai (Group - Company Secretary & Compliance Officer) and Nishant Desai (signed by) disclosed voting results for Postal Ballot resolutions on June 06, 2026, via remote e-voting.
SEBI passed an adjudication order dated October 27, 2026, levying an ₹8 lakh penalty on Gretex Corporate Services for due diligence lapses as merchant banker to Taurian MPS IPO.
